meta.title: QQ Chat Presets & Mode Console
meta.description: DSH-side plugin for the QQ bridge (merge of the former QQ Chat Presets and QQ Mode Console bundles): the qq-chat / qq-chat-v2 agent presets with a shared tool allow-list guard, plus the qq-mode settings namespace used to switch the bridge mode (chat, closed-agent, first- or second-generation simulation).
